int_name: N BROAD ST & SPRING GARDEN ST

result.summary: The image shows a wide urban intersection with marked zebra crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and sidewalks on both sides. While basic infrastructure is present, the multi-lane roadway creates a significant crossing distance for pedestrians without a central refuge.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross four lanes of traffic plus parking lanes without a median refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Pavement Degradation
hazards.description: Cracking and wear in the asphalt within the crosswalk area could pose a trip hazard.
hazards.location_in_image: Road surface within the marked crosswalk

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

result.summary: The intersection features wide sidewalks and signalized crossings, but pedestrians face significant exposure due to the multi-lane roadway width. The lack of a median refuge and faded crosswalk markings further diminish the safety of the environment for those crossing.

result.summary: The intersection presents a wide, multi-lane roadway with a long unprotected crossing distance for pedestrians. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and traffic signals are present, the crosswalk markings are significantly faded and there is a lack of pedestrian-centric safety features like refuge islands.

hazards.description: The excessive width of the roadway exposes pedestrians to multiple lanes of traffic for a long duration without a safe place to stop.

result.summary: The image depicts a dense urban intersection with marked crosswalks and wide sidewalks adjacent to commercial buildings. A large refuse truck is stopped within the intersection, creating a significant visual and physical obstruction for pedestrians attempting to cross.

hazards.name: Large Vehicle Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: A large trash truck is stopped in the roadway, completely blocking sightlines between pedestrians in the crosswalk and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the image, occupying the roadway and crosswalk area

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Implement strict 'no standing' zones near the intersection to prevent large vehicles from parking or stopping where they block sightlines at the crosswalk.
